HEADLINE
Streamline new hire integration

SUBHEADLINE
For people ops leads, manual onboarding plan creation takes too much time.

WHAT THIS IS
A focused tool that helps people ops leads move from manual onboarding plan creation takes too much tim to streamline new hire integration.

WHO IT IS FOR
People Ops Leads

THE PROBLEM
Manual onboarding plan creation takes too much time

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL
Spreadsheets was not designed for people ops leads. It covers the broader category but lacks the specific mechanics this problem requires, forcing people ops leads to patch gaps with manual workarounds that slow outcomes.

HOW IT WORKS
Automates plans based on role, team, and skills gaps.

KEY BENEFITS
Early users of HR Onboarding Automation reach their first outcome without the overhead of general-purpose alternatives.

CALL TO ACTION
Get started with HR Onboarding Automation.
